title: Delivering Better for Chicago
body: Dion's Chicago Dream believes nutritious food should be a lived reality, not an aspiration, and has built the infrastructure to prove it: 325,000 pounds of fresh produce moved monthly to more than 5,400 households a week across every Chicago neighborhood. The Dream Box extends that reliability to the last few feet of the journey.

feature.title: One platform, first proven on the front step.
feature.body: Built on Veranda's platform, it lives on a stoop or a community site with no power, Wi-Fi, or installer required, running a year on battery over long-range wireless. Insulated and sensor-equipped, it keeps produce and other perishables fresh, admits only the authorized carrier, and flags anything out of the ordinary in real time, so a delivery that reaches the block also reaches the family behind schedules, work shifts, and closed doors. The Veranda Dashboard gives the program one view across every box in the network: what's arrived, its condition, and who has access. Dion's Chicago Dream is building the case that communities don't change by accident, they're built; Veranda is proud to build alongside them, closing the final gap between a meal grown and a meal received.
